_comment: Manifest of the GolfCraft local dev backend. `bash scripts/dev-up.sh` brings up everything that's down (idempotent) and handles the cloudflared tunnel URL -> common/constants.ts SERVER_URL -> scene rebuild automatically. `bash scripts/dev-down.sh` stops it (MySQL/podman is left running).

services.name: mysql
services.managed: podman (persists on its own; NOT a background task that dies)

services.name: web
services.note: REST: /api/get-course, /api/parts, /api/get-login-id. If DOWN, login silently falls back to the junk PlayFab account (GC=1000).

services.name: colyseus
services.note: Defines mission-room. onAuth gates joins by the player's PlayFab current_mission. Plain ts-node, no auto-reload.

services.name: tunnel
services.note: wss for the game WebSocket (bevy deno_websocket only trusts public CAs). URL changes EVERY run -> dev-up.sh writes it into common/constants.ts SERVER_URL and rebuilds the scene.

services.name: preview
services.note: SDK7 scene preview server. Realm = http://127.0.0.1:8001 (8000 left free on purpose).

services.name: chain-playfab
services.note: Golfclub NFT minter + ERC721 metadata. NOT needed for missions (the /groups ECONNREFUSED at Colyseus boot is harmless), but dev-up.sh now starts it too.
